summary: Delta review. All seven previous findings are addressed except the T-15 placement nit. The major join gap is closed: e2e/scrutiny-flow.spec.js drives a real page run (via window.__vc) from the counter hold to the auto-opened panel, with the town and 10/6/4 lines, one leaderboard entry, and no panel in Polling Day. Mutations in scratch copies confirm it bites: deleting the ScrutinyPanel.open call fails the panel test; dropping record() at 'won' fails the filing and quit tests; forcing the scene clock to run (endT ternary) fails the panel test; removing the nudge() call fails the Punganur 40-seed storm test. npm test (89) and npm run e2e (10) pass on the working tree. record() is once-per-run (reset in start()), the win is saved at 'won' so a Quit mid-scene keeps it, and result.scrutiny is set at the tear on the same object that was saved. nudge() is bounded (3 tiles, flow-field closer, no-op if none). Remaining items are minor/nit only.

findings.issue: The three new test names carry no planned case ID, which breaks the plan-to-test traceability rule. They cover T-17 and T-18 in the real page.
findings.fix: Prefix the names with the case they extend, e.g. 'T-17/T-18 filing a nomination plays the scrutiny scene, ...'.

findings.issue: The quit test says the panel 'never opens' but checks panelOpen once, right after Quit. A regression where finish() still ran after Quit would open the panel about 10 s later and go unnoticed.
findings.fix: Rename to 'does not open it at that moment', or assert window.__vc.running stays false and the panel is absent after a short fixed wait.

findings.issue: The comment calls window.__vc a 'read-only hook', but scrutiny-flow.spec.js now mutates sim state through it (mode, docs, position, submitT).
findings.fix: Reword to 'hook for automated playtests' so the comment matches its use.

findings.issue: Not fixed: the CP-5 T-15 ally test still sits in the CP-6 scrutiny test file.
findings.fix: Move it to test/characters.test.js (or wherever the other T-15 tests live).
